notes.title: New DLC "Tales & Strives" Released!
notes.content:
The "Tales & Strives" puzzle set contains 10 new puzzles representing 2 new themes with 5 puzzles in each, respectively - FREE demo puzzles included!

This patch also introduces some minor fixes:
- It's now possible to delete any profile progress from the profiles menu.
- Added tooltips/hints over in-game buttons.
- Fixed an issue when mouse clicks were sometimes not registered when picking up a fragment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3691010

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2 - Some pictures upgrade
notes.content:
We have redrawn several paintings that were created first - to better match the latest works: Paris, Rome, Train & Monkey. Corresponding classic cuts have been updated, as well, so expect ongoing classic progress for those to be reset after patch (if any).

We hope, that you will like the new images, and feel free to vote for the next remakes!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Released first DLC with 8 new puzzles, introducing two new themes - Music & Birds.
- Fixed issues with Simplified Chinese localization in context menu.
- Fixed issue with random cut and random play modes at the same time weren't being actually random.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
- Added 10 variations of "Shards" board cut, since players reported, that single one feels repetitive. Just to note, these cuts still uses the same hexagonal kites grid - not GM1/GM2 style pieces, yet
- Added alternative condition for getting "Mastery" achievement. From now on, you can also get it for completing all puzzles in "Classic" play mode (regardless of board cut). For those, who already qualified - just get into the game to count.
- Puzzle black hints now can be quickly toggled using button in the gameplay screen
- Fixed an issue when player's "profile.save" file was being corrupted in some situations

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
- Added some community content (trading cards, badges, profile backgrounds), which is atm is in review by Valve, but should be available soon
- Added an option for splitting disc rotations (left and right separately)
- Fixed all issues with dials rotations
- Fixed an issue with outlines for the fragments being too bold in some situations

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
- Added save slots, so now players can split game progress on the same account or start a new game
- Language selection is now available in the game options
- Updated application icons with high resolution versions
- Refined Credits screen with team roles and clarified, that artworks are hand-drawn, not AI
- Fixed an issue with puzzle partial progress sometimes not being saved, when exiting to the Collection screen
- Fixed an issue with detecting initial native screen resolution
- Fixed some issues with German localization (thanks to Syphia)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Increased number of starting fragments up to 6  for the "Flood" game mode
- You can quit to the desktop from any screen with the progress saved
- Added an option to switch off slow idle rotation of the fragments on disc
- Increased range for game board brightness option
- Top and bottom fragments on the locked disc lane now doesn't fade to screen edges
- Opposite lane of disc is not auto-rotated, when the mouse is over locked one

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Added Classic Mode which starts with all fragments on the table
- Added option to change game board brightness
- Removed edge border thick lines for more precise matching of edge fragments 
- Achievements "Play All Rules" & "Play All Cuts" now works as expected (within all puzzles played, not a single one)
- Mouse cursor is now hidden for the current fragment in hand
- If switched off, hints are now displayed only for the first puzzle being completed in game

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: - Black area hints are now hidden by default. Still can be switched ON in options.
